target_problem: A target-domain decision depends on choosing among rival causal accounts that fit the same observed outcome.
structural_correspondence: Both source and target contain rival explanations constrained by one problem situation.
The target can expose details that must differ if one causal account is true and another is false.
warrant: Activate case by case only when target-domain evidence supplies rival mechanisms and a discriminating observation or intervention; explanatory vocabulary alone is insufficient.
target_evidence: User-provided or independently verified chronology, mechanism, comparison, intervention, or process evidence relevant to the target case.
disanalogies: Organizational outcomes are open systems with strategic actors and confounders.
Hard to vary does not itself establish causation or forecast an intervention's effect.
failure_conditions: Only temporal sequence supports the causal story.
resulting_claims: A Skill-owned provisional diagnosis and a discriminating test, never a Deutsch-attributed business conclusion.
